name: Playing Poker with Natasha Romanoff
description_md:
Hi! I'm IlEmperatore, a Spanish YouTuber who dedicates his channel exclusively to share Marvel Champions content since the game came out:
https://www.youtube.com/ilemperatore

**Can Black Widow win only on Alter-Ego form? Yes! Just playing poker!**

It has always been in my mind the unique possibility that Black Widow has to thwart and confuse in alter ego villain with [Covert Ops](/card/08003) . 
What would happen if you also add all the Justice cards that that can be played in Alter-Ego form? Here you have the result:

**INFINITE LOOP**
With 2x [Black Widow's Gauntlet](/card/08007) + [Safe House #29](/card/08005) + [Counterintelligence](/card/08017) you have an infinite loop that avoids you 3 threats from the plan each turn. You discard [Counterintelligence](/card/08017) to avoid a threat of 3 and, on your next turn, you recover it with [Safe House #29](/card/08005) you play it with the 2x [Black Widow's Gauntlet](/card/08007) winning a card each turn!

**SO MUCH CARD DRAW**
Many of the encounter cards have a surge in Alter-Ego form, making it easier for [Espionage](/card/08033) to trigger, you can have 3 on the board, drawing 6 cards in a single turn.

**CONTROL BOARD**
You can control the threat very easily with cards like [Foiled!](/card/09038),[Beat Cop](/card/10029)and [Covert Ops](/card/08003) The card [Spycraft](/card/08018) is essential to avoid encounters like [Advance](/card/01186) or [Shadow of the Past](/card/01190) that can make things difficult for you. When the villain plays a weapon or accessory, stare at him with a smile on your face, you have the aces.

**ALLIES**
Allies is the only way to do constant damage to the villain. The best of all is [Lockjaw](/card/05018) that it assures you at least 2 damage per turn, but [Quake](/card/08012) can be core to control your board. (this is version 2.0 added [Nick Fury](/card/01084) and [Daredevil](/card/01058) for more damage)

Love for everyone!
